decisions.reason: The offshore and renewable energy management unit sits close to the core shipmanagement business and targets a growing offshore wind market whose value is still unfolding, so the option is cheap to hold and still worth keeping.
Crew and corporate travel management builds directly on the firm's large crew operations at low carrying cost, and post-pandemic recovery of crew travel leaves upside unresolved.
An online vessel information portal supports client transparency and the digitalisation trend at modest maintenance cost, though it may be folded into broader digital platforms.

The mobile performance app supports the firm's goal of cleaner shipping, but it risks being superseded by other digital tools, so the drop probability is moderate while uncertainty about uptake remains.
